summary_counts.FRONTEND_TESTS: 10/13 PASS (3 FAIL due to master-status bug)

critical.issue: Returns 0 counts for all master types despite data existing. Root cause: sample data loader doesn't add tenant_id to records, but master-status queries with tenant_id filter.
critical.root_cause: Sample data loader at line 847-849 does delete_many({}) and insert_many(docs) without tenant_id. The master-status endpoint queries with {'tenant_id': tenant_id} which returns 0.
critical.fix_suggestion: Add tenant_id to each record before inserting in sample data loader

minor.issue: Returns 400 because sku_ean_master is not in VALID list. Sample data creates sku_ean_master but preview only accepts sku_master.
minor.fix_suggestion: Add 'sku_ean_master' to VALID list in preview endpoint

ui_bugs.root_cause: Depends on master-status endpoint which has bug

ui_bugs.root_cause: Depends on master-status endpoint which has bug

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 66 found critical bug in sample data loader - it doesn't add tenant_id to records. This causes master-status to return 0 counts, which cascades to: (1) Sample Data Banner showing incorrectly, (2) Master cards showing 0, (3) Preview buttons hidden. The data IS there and works in dashboards (BI Dashboard shows ₹301.8Cr revenue). Fix needed in /app/backend/routes/upload.py load_sample_data function.
